ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with a high-frequency distribution of high-intensity (white) punctate pixels, estimated at a macro ratio of 0.15:1 white to black.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-intensity punctate speckling distributed across the entire visible dark surface; high-intensity white geometric patches and clusters are concentrated at the distal tips and along the lower-left peripheral margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees; deep penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (2-8 pixels) along the continuous boundary; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits more pronounced jagged peaks compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to convex trajectories along the outer lateral margins toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial distribution of circular and oval high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) ranging from 1 to 12 pixels in diameter, scattered across the primary dark pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct yellowish-white, high-relief calcified protrusions localized on the distal tips of both lobes; right lobe tip shows a highly irregular, jagged terminus suggesting significant prior tissue loss or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Characteristic high-density punctate pigmentation pattern (starfield effect) covering approximately 85% of the visible ventral surface area.
